court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Mrs. Himani Akash Kamal vs Mr. Akash Kanwarlal Kamal
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2006 and had a son born in 2008. The wife filed for divorce due to cruel treatment by the husband and was granted custody of the child. She remarried within 90 days of the decree.

legal_principles.principle: The appeal period for filing an appeal under Section 19 of the Family Courts Act is 90 days from the date of decree in the Family Court.
legal_principles.held: In view of the 3 Judges' Bench Judgment of this Court in the matter of Shivram Dodanna Shetty v/s. Sharmila Shivram Shetty, the appeal period for filing appeal u/s. 19 of the Family Courts Act is 90 days from the date of Decree in Family Court.
cited_cases: Shivram Dodanna Shetty v/s. Sharmila Shivram Shetty, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to exclude time period required for obtaining certified copy, etc. under Limitation Act.
legal_principles.held: It is needless to mention that all provisions of exclusion of time period required for obtaining certified copy etc. under Limitation Act, would apply here.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is dismissed, and the interim order passed earlier is vacated.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court appeals
